args.title: Fix toast messages for errors and success
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error messages shown as toasts currently use the same polite live region as success messages, which causes screen readers to wait before announcing them. They are also set to auto-dismiss after five seconds, meaning users may miss important error messages.
